findings.label: Hardcoded hotel_id in OrderStatusUpdated
findings.issue: The event sets $this->hotelId to a placeholder UUID '41b094f8-7ed2-4af0-bd16-6f0533e34544' instead of reading $order->hotel_id. Multi-hotel systems will broadcast incorrect hotel context to all subscribers.

findings.label: Dual event listeners on kitchen channel
findings.issue: echoService.subscribeToKitchenOrderUpdates listens for both 'order.status.changed' and 'order.created' on the same private channel, but broadcast routing may differ between events. Verify the intent: if both events should reach the kitchen, confirm OrderCreated targets private-kitchen.orders.update. If only status updates should, remove the order.created listener.

findings.label: Missing guest/order identity in broadcasts
findings.issue: Broadcast events include order number and guest name but no guest_id or guest identifier. Kitchen staff cannot verify which guest placed an order without a separate API query. The frontend authorizer has guest QR token access, but broadcast payloads do not use it.
